label: 头条号发布图文（基础版）

steps.expression: (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ai-assistant-drawer'); if (!drawer || !drawer.offsetParent) return { action: 'absent' }; const close = drawer.querySelector('svg.close-btn'); if (close) close.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return { action: close ? 'dispatched' : 'no-close-btn' }; })()

(() => { const radios = [...document.querySelectorAll('.article-cover .byte-radio')]; const target = radios.find((r) => (r.textContent || '').trim() === '单图'); if (!target) return { action: 'no-cover-section' }; target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); const input = target.querySelector('input'); if (input && !input.checked) input.click(); return { action: 'ok', checked: !!(input && input.checked) }; })()
